title: This text highlights two main products from Liaoning, China: 'Cuttlefish' Iron Flat Washers and DEER brand refillable pencils. The Iron Flat Washers are made from high-quality iron plates and are designed to enhance the durability of connections by distributing pressure and preventing wear. They are available in various standards and sizes, and are exported globally, earning a strong reputation. The DEER brand pencils, produced by the Dalian Pencil Plant, boast a long history and advanced production techniques. They are known for their smooth writing, durability, and attractive designs, and are sold in over thirty countries. Both products emphasize quality and reliability, appealing to a wide market.
